name: ai-dlc
description: The agent-facing half of AI-DLC. Five gate-aware subagents that each refuse the one move that would corrupt the method — an implementer that never accepts its own work, an explorer that never signs its own discovery draft, a reviewer that only rejects — plus two PreToolUse hooks that turn the rules CLAUDE.md states in prose into refusals: no destructive commands, no hand-edits of the controller's state or its generated artifacts, and no credentials in the transcript, the repo or a push. Pairs with the ai-dlc-core and ai-dlc-verify skills, which hold the workflow and the gates.
